title: Free, Unbound by Anyone
overview: Chloe decides to leave her life as an agent behind to start over as "Victoria Sellars" and seek her happiness.

title: No One Should Feel Sorry for Me
overview: After finding a job and a place, Victoria is reunited with Jeffrey.

title: I Couldn't Become Someone to Be Depended Upon
overview: Victoria and Jeffrey attend the royal ball, and an incident happens.

title: Are You Going to Arrest Me?
overview: After being followed, Victoria takes down a mysterious man in mask.

title: Prepared to Pay for What I've Done
overview: Victoria gets the attacker from the dance party out of prison.

title: Think About This Child's Happiness
overview: Just when Victoria seems to be gaining allies, a Barone shows up and asks to adopt Nonna.

title: I Made Great Memories
overview: Nonna comes back, but Victoria makes a decision to leave.

title: I Am Truly Thankful
overview: Victoria and Nonna live in Randall under aliases, and Jeffrey resigns from his job to find Victoria.

title: No Matter What Happens in the Future
overview: Jeffrey finds Victoria at the Cadiz summer festival, and they confess their secrets to each other.
